zh-CN.title: 投稿人邀请范围调整
items: 邀请新的投稿者时，现在只会展示并允许选择当前好友
后端会再次校验好友关系，避免通过过期页面或直接请求绕过限制

en.title: Safer co-author invitations
items: Inviting a new submission author now only shows and accepts your current friends
The server verifies the friendship again so stale screens or direct requests cannot bypass the rule
